tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic's partnership with GSA will bring Claude to all levels of government. Confirmed by Anthropic.
Suno and Anthropic are being sued for allegedly scraping copyrighted music from Madonna, Johnny Cash, and Joni Mitchell to train their models. Confirmed by CNET.
Delaware is proposing a plan that would allow artificial intelligence agents to run entire businesses with a 30-month sandbox period. Confirmed by Ars Technica.
After Anthropic's IPO, founders and a trust hold majority control of the company, limiting the influence of common shareholders. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
Anthropic's IPO filing reveals massive compute spending and raises governance questions as the artificial intelligence industry continues to grow. Confirmed by Fortune.
